description: We are Mohammed Altaie, Aileen Martinez and Giovanni Joseph. For the challenge "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" we built Pulsaris: an offline health check-in that tells an astronaut what needs attention, why, and what to do next, using NASA research for its scoring and guidance. Our skills: React and TypeScript development, UX design and health-science research. We care about space medicine and tools people can trust. Team is complete; no new members needed.
